fields.title: Narrate's word renumbering never runs over a section that is still being numbered
fields.description: Narrate's re-stamp effect, which renumbers a section's word spans when the book's word list arrives, does not wait for a wrap already in progress, does not register its own wrap, and checks for cancellation only after the loop. Page's re-stamp has all three guards. Reproduce first with a deterministic test, then add the same three guards inside Narrate's own FoliateView, or close as not reachable.
fields.notes: origin: Blurby.Brain1 ruling TQ-B3 on BLOCK-TEXT-ORDER-1, 2026-11-03 (one item per mode runtime); Findings F-013. Not a release gate; no shared core.
